newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian 6-mth T-bill yield falls to 61.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russian 6-mth T-bill yield falls to 61.25 pct.

text.p: The average yield on an issue of six-month GKO discount Treasury bills fell to 61.25 percent at an auction on Wednesday from 67.97 percent at the last auction of six-month paper a week ago, the central bank said.
Dealers had forecast an average yield in the 56-61 percent range.
Full details of the issue follow:
Issue volume 7.50 trln rbls 7.50 trln rbls
Earlier the finance ministry raised 1.11 trillion roubles when it auctioned a new 2.00 trillion rouble tranche of the two-year OFZ government bond maturing in March 1998 (series 24007).
That takes total proceeds from Wednesday's auctions to just over six trillion roubles.
The finance ministry is also paying off six trillion roubles of maturing six-month T-bills (series 22025).
